name: ingenidev, Iraq – IQD Currency Symbol Changer مغير رمز عملة الدينار العراقي
author: ingenidev by Bright Vortex LLC

sections.description:
By default, WooCommerce uses the currency symbol for the Iraqi Dinar (IQD) as “د.ع”. This ingenidev plugin changes it to “IQD”.

Privacy notices

This plugin, in itself, does not:

  • track users
  • write any user personal data to the database
  • send any data to external servers
  • make use of cookies

Our plugins

The following plugins are recommended by ingenidev :

  • Code Widget for Elementor This plugin for Elementor adds a widget for a code snipet to your pages, the snipet includes code formatting and a built in copy to clipboard function.
  • Cash on Delivery Shield a plugin that allows you to disable Cash on Delivery payment method for orders made by users who are not logged in.

How to Change the IQD (Iraqi Dinar) Currency Symbol in WooCommerce?

This simple plugin converts the display of IQD (Iraqi Dinar) currency on your WP Woocommerce website from Arabic to English.

By default, WooCommerce uses د.ع as the symbol for the IQD (Iraqi Dinar), which may not always align with your website’s branding or customer preferences. If you want to replace د.ع with IQD, this plugin makes the process effortless.

Why Change the IQD Symbol in WooCommerce?

Many businesses prefer displaying IQD instead of د.ع for better readability, consistency, and international appeal. Some common reasons include:
Maintaining a uniform look across your website, especially when using English as the primary language.
Enhancing clarity for non-Arabic-speaking customers who may not recognize د.ع as IQD.
Improving compatibility with third-party payment gateways or invoice systems that use IQD instead.

Features of the IQD Currency Symbol Changer Plugin:

✅ Instantly Replace “د.ع” with “IQD” across your WooCommerce store.
✅ No coding required – simple plug-and-play functionality.
✅ Works seamlessly with all WooCommerce-compatible themes and plugins.
✅ Lightweight and fast – no performance impact on your store.

How to Use This Plugin?

1.Install and activate the IQD Currency Symbol Changer plugin.
2.The plugin automatically updates the currency symbol from د.ع to IQD across your WooCommerce store.
3.No additional configuration is required – it just works!

Who Should Use This Plugin?

WooCommerce store owners in Irak or those selling to customers in Irak.
Businesses that prefer the “IQD” format over the Arabic “د.ع”.
Websites that use English as the primary language and want a consistent currency display.

Get Started Today!

Upgrade your WooCommerce store’s currency display with the IQD Currency Symbol Changer and ensure a better shopping experience for your customers.
